metadata.scope: Solo development-build rail-view survey; real XR/AI/physics. Enemy invincibility, full fuel before each leg, scripted throttle and stationary yaw warps. No interior/crew-load acceptance. No clocks/resolution overrides. Buffered capture; final file writing excluded. Synthetic default-duck stress: real remote-body arm IK/fingers, synthetic lip poses; all dummy rigs follow each view in a visible forward fan. Production flashlight settings, scripted sweeps. No remote transport/voice decoding/AI targeting; one real local rig included in total. Compound has no synthetic load. Local visual hands use fixed head-relative animated targets to avoid unattended controller poses obstructing the view; real XR head, normal local IK/finger/render callbacks retained. Local first-person head hidden each pose.
metadata.crewLightSettings: Spot; range=75; intensity=250; angle=25; shadows=None; remotePriority=Auto; one local ForcePixel

notes: Update intervals are measured between Unity Updates; they are not compositor presentation FPS.
Only valid=1 samples analyzed; valid=0 lacks focus/tracking, valid=2 is viewpoint settling.
CPU/GPU fields are OpenXR META milliseconds. Missing counters are unavailable, not zero cost.
When provider counters are absent, use OVRPlugin GetPerfMetricsFloat seconds ×1000. Raw OVR values are retained in frames.csv; this build rounds them to 0.0001 seconds (0.1 ms).

native_* uses this game PID's VrApi one-second performance reports, aligned by device UTC with runner metadata. Boundary-spanning reports are excluded. App is GPU milliseconds, cross-checked against OVR Metrics app_gpu_time_microseconds.
Main/render thread profiler durations may include waits; do not equate them with active CPU cost.
A completed solo rail survey does not establish interior, combat, multiplayer or release-build acceptance.
Check head pose and visual framing before comparing runs. Thermal/charging context is in the adjacent preflight files.
